verdict.line: You lose if you walk into Q-E poke without a plan; you win every all-in you force inside 550 units.

brief.thesis: Jayce's Hammer Stance E (Thundering Blow) and Cannon Stance Q (Shock Blast) exist to keep you outside your own threat range, but Volibear's E (Sky Splitter) has 1200 range and threatens him from the same distance his poke does. The matchup is decided by who controls the gap: Jayce wants space to kite, Volibear wants to close it with Q (Thundering Smash) before W (Frenzied Maul) stacks pile up.

theirWindow.when: Cannon Stance with mana for Shock Blast
theirWindow.what: He can fire Shock Blast from 600 range and kite with Hyper Charge attack speed. Don't walk straight at him in a line he can poke freely; angle behind minions and bait the Q (To the Skies!/Shock Blast) on cooldown (16/14/12/10/8s) before committing.

yourWindow.when: Jayce's E (Thundering Blow/Acceleration Gate) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Without the knockback, he has no way to peel you off once you land Q (Thundering Smash) and stun him. Cooldown is 20/18/16/14/12s, so track when he last used it and burst Frenzied Maul twice in that window.

powerCurve.note: Ranged poke before your Q unlocks real threat
Shock Blast through Acceleration Gate punishes approaches
Your R threatens all-ins Jayce must respect
W double-cast burst outscales his trade damage
Full build Volibear bulldozes kited pokes

start.why: Sustains you through Jayce's Q-E poke (48 games, 46.1% win rate) so you're not forced off wave by chip damage alone.

boots.why: Reduces incoming auto-attack damage from Hyper Charge resets and poke autos; the 56.2% pick rate reflects how often Jayce leans on basic attacks between cooldowns.

core.why: Core item in the highest win-rate late build path (50.7% over 69 games) that scales your on-hit and survivability together.
Pairs with Dusk and Dawn in the top build path, feeding the attack speed that turns W (Frenzied Maul) stacks into real DPS.
Boosts the healing from your W's double-cast and from Sky Splitter's shield uptime, both of which Jayce's poke-heavy kit is trying to outlast.

situational.when: he builds into heavy auto-attack scaling from Cannon Stance crit/AS items
you want the highest-win-rate aggressive path (60.3% over 73 games) and are ahead enough to snowball
you need wave clear to answer his ranged push and reset lane state
his damage is mostly physical autos and you need flat damage reduction

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramping attack speed rewards landing W (Frenzied Maul) twice in a trade window, which is exactly how you convert a stun into a kill before he can kite away.

summoners.why: Ignite closes out all-ins you force with Q (Thundering Smash) before Jayce's mobility and healing cuts let him reset; this combo is run in 56.4% of games at a 45.4% win rate, the most common pairing in the matchup.

playing.title: Track his stance before every trade
playing.detail: Hammer Stance means Thundering Blow can knock you off him after your stun; Cannon Stance means Shock Blast and Hyper Charge are live. Only commit Q (Thundering Smash) when you know which tool he has up.

playing.title: Use E to answer poke, not just to engage
playing.detail: Sky Splitter's 1200 range matches his poke distance and slows anyone it hits. Fire it back whenever he lands a Shock Blast so he isn't trading for free.

playing.title: Save Q for after his E is down
playing.detail: Thundering Blow's 20/18/16/14/12s cooldown is your green light. If he just used it to knock back a minion or ally, that's your window to stun and double W before he can create space again.

playing.title: Double-cast W inside the stun
playing.detail: Frenzied Maul's bonus damage and heal on the second cast only matters if you land both hits during the Q stun; prioritize that combo over using E mid-fight.

playing.title: Don't walk Acceleration Gates
playing.detail: If he drops a gate in Cannon Stance, stepping through gives him a faster, longer-range, harder-hitting Shock Blast. Go around minions instead of through the gate's line.

playing.title: Hold R for turret dives, not poke wars
playing.detail: Stormbringer's 110-160s cooldown is too long to waste contesting ranged pressure. Save it to close distance on a kited target or disable his tower on a dive.

playing.title: Shove and reset after level 6
playing.detail: Once you have Sky Splitter and Stormbringer, pushing waves fast denies his ranged farm advantage and forces him to either match your shove or give up CS.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the tactical reading of cooldown windows and stance tells is my own analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Jayce’s (Q)-(E) pokes. Use [E] to contest lane while using [Q] to close in to gain the upper hand in combat.
